verdict.rationale: llamafile has no tracking to opt out of: models run entirely on-device with "no cloud, no data sharing" and work fully offline. The server sandbox forbids outbound connect() entirely. A hands-on user also reports it runs with zero network connection. missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that no telemetry or usage analytics exist, and documentation that the outbound-network block applies outside server mode (e.g. the --cli mode).
